facts.fact: Law No. 6 of 2022 on Electronic Transactions, an 87-article law issued by the House of Representatives at Tobruk on 4 October 2022, regulates electronic signatures, certification service providers and electronic messages, and by Article 87 takes effect from its date of issuance.
